summary: Frontend-only verification of (A) the new Inertia Follow-list page (Profile/FollowList.vue) and (B) the profile-show.js inline-form auto-open fix, on the preview URL. RESULTS: all 5 requested scenarios PASS. (1) Auth guard: curl + browser confirm /u/seller/followers 302 -> /login when unauthenticated. (2) As buyer@test.com, /u/seller 'Takip Et' -> AJAX follow OK; /u/seller/followers then renders header 'test satıcı' + '@seller', back arrow href=/u/seller, tabs 'Takipçiler 1' (active) + 'Takip Edilenler 0', one row = 'test alıcı' / '@buyer' with avatar; buyer's OWN row correctly has NO follow button (is_self). Page <title> = 'artirdim | test satıcı — Takipçiler'. (3) Clicking 'Takip Edilenler' navigates to /u/seller/following, that tab becomes active and the empty state 'Henüz kimse takip edilmiyor' + sub-text renders. (4) Toggle button tested on /u/buyer/following (row 'test satıcı'): 'Takip Ediliyor' -> click -> 'Takip Et' -> click -> 'Takip Ediliyor', class .following added/removed, ZERO frame navigations (pure AJAX) and ZERO console/page errors. (5) PROFILE fix as seller@test.com: drawer opens, all 4 etabs switch; on GÜVENLİK, wrong current password + valid new password submit -> after reload the drawer re-opens on GÜVENLİK AND #pass-form has class 'pf-inline-form open', is_visible()=True, showing red rgb(239,68,68) 'Mevcut şifreniz hatalı.' (the iteration_10 bug is FIXED). Also verified the e-mail form path: wrong password on the e-mail change -> #email-form auto-opens with visible 'Şifreniz hatalı.'. Password and e-mail were NOT changed. (6) Regression: guest /u/seller renders fully (hero, badge, stats 4/0/1/0/4.3, 4 auction cards), all 3 public tabs switch, no follow/edit controls for guest, no console errors. Data restored: buyer unfollowed seller at the end (seller followers back to 0).

ui_bugs.issue: Tab links and person rows use plain <a :href> (full browser page reload) while pagination uses Inertia <Link>. Switching Takipçiler/Takip Edilenler therefore does a full document reload, losing SPA state - inconsistent with the rest of the converted app.

After an AJAX follow/unfollow the .fl-tab-count badges (and the target user's follower count) are not updated - counts stay stale until a reload, even though FollowController@toggle returns follower_count.

toggleFollow() swallows all failures (catch { /* noop */ }) and ignores non-2xx responses (403 self-follow, 419 CSRF expiry, 500). The user gets no feedback and the button silently keeps its old state. Consider checking res.ok and showing a toast.

The reactive `state` map is built once in setup and keyed by array INDEX. Inertia reuses the same component instance for same-component navigation (pagination <Link> / tab visits handled by Inertia), so on page 2 the per-row follow state can be stale/mismatched with the new fl.people. Recommend deriving state from props with a watch/computed keyed by username. Not reproducible with current seed data (<24 followers).
No data-testid on follow-list elements (tabs, rows, follow button, empty state); tests had to rely on fl-* CSS classes.

issues: Follow-list page content is very sparse at 1920px - the row block spans the full width with a lot of empty space to the right; a max-width container would look better.

'Takip Ediliyor' button renders in red/danger colour which reads like an error state rather than a neutral 'following' state (public profile uses 'Takibi Bırak' for the same state - wording differs between the two pages).

action_items: Optional: convert .fl-tab / .fl-item links to Inertia <Link> so tab switching stays SPA (pagination already uses Link).
Optional: handle non-OK responses in FollowList toggleFollow (res.ok check + toast) instead of silently ignoring, and update the tab count badges from the returned follower_count.
Optional: derive the per-row follow state from props (watch/computed keyed by username) instead of a setup-time index map, to avoid stale state on paginated navigation.
Optional: add data-testid attributes to follow-list tabs/rows/follow button.
critical_code_review_comments: FollowController::renderList builds the avatar fallback inline; the same ui-avatars fallback logic exists elsewhere (profile pages) - extract into a User accessor to stay DRY.
csrf_token() is shipped in the Inertia page props (fl.csrf) purely for the fetch call; using Inertia's router.post (which handles CSRF/XSRF automatically) would remove this duplication.
Wording inconsistency: public profile uses 'Takibi Bırak' while the follow list uses 'Takip Ediliyor' for the same state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 5 requested scenarios pass; only minor/robustness observations remain

seed_data_creation: No new records left behind. Buyer temporarily followed seller (to populate the followers list) and then unfollowed at the end - seller follower count back to 0. Seller password and e-mail unchanged (both change attempts used a deliberately wrong current password).
test_credentials: buyer@test.com / password, seller@test.com / password (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - both valid and unchanged after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_11: FollowList.vue verified end-to-end. Selectors: .fl-root, .fl-header-name, .fl-header-sub, .fl-back, .fl-tab(+.active)/.fl-tab-count, .fl-item, .fl-name, .fl-handle, .fl-avatar img, .fl-follow-btn(+.following), .fl-empty/.fl-empty-title. Browser sessions do NOT persist between browser_automation_tool runs - always log in inside the same script. Login page has exactly 2 credential inputs (type=text + type=password) and a submit button; the 'Unexpected token !' pageerror and localStorage sandbox pageerrors appear only on the login/profile shell in the preview iframe and are harmless; /storage/*.jpg 403s expected. profile-show.js INLINE_MAP fix confirmed working for both #pass-form (validation error) and #email-form (wrong password). Not exercised: the email_success/password_success flash path via config.drawer_inline (would require actually changing credentials) and follow-list pagination (needs >24 followers).
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_10's hidden-error bug is resolved: profile-show.js now maps the first error field via INLINE_MAP (email/confirmemailpassword -> email-form, currentpassword/password/password_confirmation -> pass-form, delete_password -> delete-form) and adds the .open class, and separately opens root.dataset.drawerInline for success flashes; .pf-inline-form.open { display:block } makes the error visible.
